textbookBox.concept: Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space, and everything around us is made of matter.

beats.en: Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space, and everything around us is made of matter.

beats.en: Matter is made of tiny particles that are too small to see, even with a simple microscope.

textbookBox.concept: In a solid the particles are tightly packed in fixed positions and can only vibrate.

beats.en: In a solid the particles are tightly packed in fixed positions and can only vibrate.
beats.speakEn: In a solid the particles are tightly packed in fixed positions and can only vibrate.

beats.en: In a liquid they are close but can slide over each other, so a liquid takes the shape of its container.
beats.speakEn: In a liquid they are close but can slide over each other, so a liquid takes the shape of its container.
